name: artamatch-children-phasor
zodiac: sidereal (Lahiri), noon UT, birth dates only
target_says: whether the historical record lists children for a couple like this
target_question: did the historical record list children for a couple like this
formula: score = bias + sum over phasors of a*cos(k*angle) + c*sin(k*angle); p = sigmoid(score)
cv_note: nested 10-fold: stepwise selection, the choice of how many phasors, and the forced-in fast bodies were all re-run inside every training fold, so this number never saw its own test couples

decomposition.note: Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, the node, Chiron and Lilith move over centuries, so their positions identify when a person was born. Removing them takes the model from 0.6905 to 0.5691; removing Jupiter and Saturn as well takes it to 0.5189, below the 0.5518 that two numbers of birth-date difference reach on their own.
